description: This file contains implementation of proxy classes for remote secure hardware operations related to identity and credential management, including provisioning and presentation functionalities, utilizing OpenSSL and Android hardware interfaces.

classes.name: RemoteSecureHardwareProvisioningProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for remote provisioning of secure hardware, providing methods for initialization, credential creation, and entry management.

classes.name: RemoteSecureHardwarePresentationProxy
classes.description: Proxy class for remote presentation operations, including key generation, request validation, and credential management.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the proxy, logging the event.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the provisioning proxy with a test credential flag.

methods.name: initializeForUpdate
methods.description: Initializes the provisioning proxy for update with document type and encrypted credential keys.

methods.name: createCredentialKey
methods.description: Creates a credential key and returns the public key certificate.

methods.name: startPersonalization
methods.description: Starts the personalization process with access control profiles and document type.

methods.name: addAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Adds an access control profile and returns its MAC.

methods.name: beginAddEntry
methods.description: Begins adding an entry with specified access control profiles.

methods.name: addEntryValue
methods.description: Adds a value to an entry and returns encrypted content.

methods.name: finishAddingEntries
methods.description: Finalizes adding entries and returns a signature.

methods.name: finishGetCredentialData
methods.description: Completes credential data retrieval, returning encrypted credential keys.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the presentation proxy with document type and encrypted credential keys.

methods.name: generateSigningKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a signing key pair, returning the public certificate and signing key blob.

methods.name: createEphemeralKeyPair
methods.description: Creates an ephemeral private key.

methods.name: createAuthChallenge
methods.description: Creates an authentication challenge.

methods.name: pushReaderCert
methods.description: Pushes a reader's X.509 certificate.

methods.name: validateRequestMessage
methods.description: Validates a request message with session transcript and signature.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Sets an authentication token with various parameters.

methods.name: validateAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Validates an access control profile with reader certificate and MAC.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntries
methods.description: Starts retrieval of entries.

methods.name: calcMacKey
methods.description: Calculates the MAC key for session.

methods.name: startRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Starts retrieval of a specific entry value.

methods.name: retrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Retrieves an entry value given encrypted content and access control profiles.

methods.name: finishRetrieval
methods.description: Completes retrieval and returns a MAC.

methods.name: deleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes a credential and returns a signature.

methods.name: proveOwnership
methods.description: Proves ownership of a credential and returns a signature.
